headline: All eleven art modules have landed: 1,877 sprites and 1,272 tiles, every pixel generated from code. Maps, the three psychology quests, the Echo Shrine and the boss are being built in parallel now, with fresh-context critics reviewing rendered output against the reference pack.

findings.text: Phaser getFrame() returns the __BASE frame for unknown names, so every missing-art guard was drawing the entire 2048px atlas across the scene.
Tile families were keyed by leaf name, so tile/woods/grass_* merged with tile/town/grass_* and the town field rendered as a two-tone checkerboard.
edgePixels treated a tile's own border as a material edge, putting a lit line on the top row of every interior tile — a horizontal band across every path and every water surface in the game.
Grass variants were tone-mismatched and non-periodic, producing per-tile seams and brightness checkerboarding. Now seamless and rank-quantised.
Flagstone stamped one identical stone pattern on every tile; now a per-tile cellular partition with the mortar groove and lit bevel on separate pixels.
One agent's in-progress edit broke every other agent's art build. Modules now load dynamically and a broken one is skipped and reported.
The hand-maintained map import list was a shared file every map author had to edit; one stale import broke the whole game. Maps and areas are now discovered by glob.
Building footprints render as bare brown rectangles extending past the building sprites; ground under a building should match its surroundings.
Town Square flagstone is one uniform slab and density falls off sharply outside it; flowerbed prop repeats too evenly across open grass.
The three trial lanterns read as floating; they need visible mounts so their role is legible before the trial starts.

comparisons.title: Town Square vs Stardew Valley world density
comparisons.verdict: Under blind A/B review. Buildings, props and NPC routines have landed; the open ground between districts is the current gap.

comparisons.title: Festival Plaza vs Stardew Night Market
comparisons.verdict: The event transformation reads: string lights, bunting, a lit ceremonial carpet, stalls and a gathered crowd. Trial lanterns still need mounts.
